metadata.name: SBP Internet Banking Framework
metadata.description: The State Bank of Pakistan Internet Banking Framework provides regulatory requirements for financial institutions in Pakistan to offer secure internet banking services while protecting customers and maintaining operational resilience.
metadata.classification_reasoning: The SBP Internet Banking Framework is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan for financial institutions offering internet banking services. Compliance is monitored through SBP supervision and reporting requirements.
metadata.framework_purpose: To establish regulatory requirements for financial institutions in Pakistan to provide secure, reliable, and customer-friendly internet banking services while protecting against fraud and cyber threats.
metadata.framework_scope: All financial institutions regulated by the State Bank of Pakistan that offer internet banking services to retail and corporate customers.
framework_objectives: Ensure secure authentication of internet banking users
Protect customer transactions from fraud and unauthorized access
Maintain availability and reliability of internet banking services
Implement effective fraud prevention and detection mechanisms
Protect customer data and privacy in digital channels
Enable secure innovation in digital banking services
metadata.target_audience: CISOs, IT Security Teams, Digital Banking Teams, Fraud Prevention Teams, and Compliance Officers of SBP-regulated financial institutions offering internet banking
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in regulatory penalties, restrictions on internet banking services, and enforcement actions as per SBP regulations.
metadata.adoption_approach: Risk-based implementation with mandatory compliance for all financial institutions offering internet banking services.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Implement multi-factor authentication for all internet banking access.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all internet banking access. At least two independent authentication factors shall be required, combining something the customer knows, has, or is.

controls.title: Password Policy
controls.description: Enforce strong password policies for internet banking credentials.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall enforce strong password policies for internet banking credentials including minimum length, complexity requirements, expiration periods, and protection against commonly used passwords.

controls.title: Session Management
controls.description: Implement secure session management for internet banking sessions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement secure session management including session timeout after inactivity, secure session tokens, prevention of concurrent sessions, and secure session termination upon logout.

controls.title: Failed Login Protection
controls.description: Implement account lockout after failed authentication attempts.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement account lockout mechanisms after a defined number of failed authentication attempts. Lockout shall be temporary or require manual unlock, with customer notification of lockout events.

controls.title: Device Registration
controls.description: Implement device registration and recognition for internet banking access.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement device registration and recognition mechanisms. Transactions from unregistered or new devices shall require additional verification. Customers shall be notified of access from new devices.

controls.title: Role-Based Access Control
controls.description: Implement role-based access control for internet banking features.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement role-based access control for internet banking features and functions. Customer access rights shall be defined based on account type and service subscriptions.

controls.title: Transaction Limits
controls.description: Implement and enforce transaction limits for internet banking.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement and enforce transaction limits for internet banking including daily limits, per-transaction limits, and cumulative limits. Limits shall be configurable and customers shall be able to set their own limits within bank-defined maximums.

controls.title: Beneficiary Management
controls.description: Implement secure beneficiary addition and management processes.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement secure beneficiary addition and management processes. Addition of new beneficiaries shall require additional authentication. Cooling-off periods shall be implemented before transactions to new beneficiaries are allowed.

controls.title: Dual Authorization for High-Value Transactions
controls.description: Require dual authorization for high-value or sensitive transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall require dual authorization for high-value or sensitive transactions in corporate internet banking. Authorization workflows shall be configurable based on transaction type and amount.

controls.title: Transaction Encryption
controls.description: Encrypt all internet banking transactions during transmission.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall encrypt all internet banking transactions during transmission using strong cryptographic protocols (TLS 1.2 or higher). End-to-end encryption shall be implemented for sensitive data.

controls.title: Transaction Signing
controls.description: Implement transaction signing for high-risk transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement transaction signing mechanisms for high-risk transactions. Transaction data shall be displayed for customer verification before signing. Digital signatures or OTPs shall be used for transaction authorization.

controls.title: Transaction Confirmation
controls.description: Provide real-time transaction confirmation to customers.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall provide real-time transaction confirmation to customers through multiple channels including on-screen confirmation, SMS alerts, and email notifications. Confirmation shall include transaction details for verification.

controls.title: Non-Repudiation
controls.description: Implement non-repudiation controls for internet banking transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement non-repudiation controls for internet banking transactions. Transaction logs shall capture sufficient detail to establish the authenticity and integrity of transactions and the identity of the initiator.

controls.title: Customer Awareness
controls.description: Provide security awareness information to internet banking customers.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall provide security awareness information to internet banking customers including safe banking practices, phishing awareness, and reporting procedures for suspicious activity.

controls.title: Secure Communication Channels
controls.description: Establish secure channels for customer communication.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish secure channels for customer communication. Sensitive information shall not be communicated via unencrypted email. Customers shall be educated to verify official bank communication channels.

controls.title: Customer Dispute Resolution
controls.description: Establish clear dispute resolution procedures for internet banking transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish clear dispute resolution procedures for internet banking transactions. Customers shall be informed of the process to dispute transactions. Dispute resolution timelines shall be defined and communicated.

controls.title: Liability Framework
controls.description: Establish clear liability framework for unauthorized transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish a clear liability framework for unauthorized internet banking transactions. Customer liability shall be limited where the customer has not acted negligently. Liability shall be clearly communicated in terms and conditions.

controls.title: Fraud Monitoring System
controls.description: Implement real-time fraud monitoring for internet banking transactions.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement real-time fraud monitoring systems for internet banking transactions. Systems shall detect anomalous patterns, unusual transaction behavior, and known fraud signatures. Alerts shall be generated for suspicious activity.

controls.title: Behavioral Analytics
controls.description: Implement behavioral analytics to detect anomalous customer behavior.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement behavioral analytics to detect anomalous customer behavior in internet banking. Customer baseline behavior shall be established, and deviations shall trigger additional verification or transaction blocking.

controls.title: Transaction Blocking
controls.description: Implement ability to block suspicious transactions in real-time.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement ability to block suspicious transactions in real-time. Transactions matching high-risk patterns or exceeding risk thresholds shall be blocked pending verification. Customers shall be notified of blocked transactions.

controls.title: Fraud Reporting to SBP
controls.description: Report significant fraud incidents to SBP as required.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall report significant internet banking fraud incidents to SBP within the required timeframe. Reports shall include details of the incident, impact, root cause analysis, and remediation actions.

controls.title: Secure Application Development
controls.description: Develop internet banking applications following secure development practices.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall develop internet banking applications following secure development practices. Security requirements shall be defined, code reviews conducted, and security testing performed before deployment.

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments of internet banking systems.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall conduct regular vulnerability assessments of internet banking systems including infrastructure, applications, and APIs. Identified vulnerabilities shall be remediated based on risk-based timelines.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Conduct annual penetration testing of internet banking systems.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall conduct annual penetration testing of internet banking systems by qualified professionals. Testing shall cover web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and network infrastructure. Findings shall be remediated before production deployment.

controls.title: API Security
controls.description: Implement security controls for internet banking APIs.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement security controls for internet banking APIs including authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and input validation. APIs shall be documented and access shall be controlled.

controls.title: Mobile Banking Security
controls.description: Implement additional security controls for mobile banking applications.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement additional security controls for mobile banking applications including app integrity verification, secure storage, jailbreak/root detection, and certificate pinning.

controls.title: High Availability
controls.description: Ensure high availability of internet banking services.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall ensure high availability of internet banking services with defined uptime targets. Redundant infrastructure shall be implemented. Failover capabilities shall be tested regularly.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Establish incident response procedures for internet banking security incidents.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall establish incident response procedures for internet banking security incidents. Procedures shall include detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned. Incident response shall be tested regularly.

controls.title: Business Continuity
controls.description: Include internet banking in business continuity planning.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall include internet banking services in business continuity planning. Recovery procedures shall be documented and tested. Recovery time objectives shall be defined and achievable.

controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.description: Implement capacity management for internet banking systems.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall implement capacity management for internet banking systems. Capacity shall be monitored and planned to meet current and future demand. Peak load testing shall be conducted regularly.

controls.title: Third Party Management
controls.description: Manage third-party risks for internet banking services.
controls.full_text: Financial institutions shall manage third-party risks for internet banking services including payment gateways, security service providers, and technology vendors. Third parties shall be assessed, monitored, and contractually bound to security requirements.
